component.name: Nixie Countdown
component.summary: Countdown timer source that shows the time on photographic Nixie tubes

description.p: Adds a countdown timer source to OBS Studio that shows the time on photographic Nixie tubes, with Start, Pause and Reset controls, hotkeys and a blink when the countdown reaches zero.
The Nixie tube digits are cut from a photograph by DANYK (https://danyk.cz/digitrony_en.html), used with credit under the author's reuse terms (https://danyk.cz/cado_en.html).
